errors.evidence: The values for the TLDR (Ours) bars are calculated incorrectly. The description treats the percentage change annotations (e.g., -1.7%, +0.6%) as absolute percentage point differences, rather than relative changes. For example, for GSM8K, it calculates 89.4 - 1.7 = 87.7, when it should be a 1.7% decrease from 89.4, which is approximately 87.9. Similarly, for AMC, it calculates 81.5 + 1.6 = 83.1, instead of an 1.6% increase on 81.5, which is approximately 82.8. This error applies to all four reported values for TLDR (Ours).
